status: workflow guidance, not a delivery commitment

es: Entender el problema, usuarios y sistemas existentes.
Acordar alcance, entregables e integraciones antes de cotizar.
Revisar arquitectura, riesgos y costos de servicios externos.
Validar la solución y documentar la entrega.
en: Understand the problem, users and existing systems.
Agree scope, deliverables and integrations before quoting.
Review architecture, risks and third-party service costs.
Validate the solution and document the handover.

rules: No guaranteed deadline without an agreed proposal.
Starting prices are reference estimates, not binding quotes.
Third-party infrastructure, subscriptions and maintenance are quoted separately.
